grader.scenario: Landline digital voice migration broke elderly mother's telecare pendant alarm and incoming caller ID
grader.notes: Exemplary 100.0% call handling a vulnerable elderly customer's Digital Voice telecare and caller-ID failure. Includes three hard-PASS tests: (1) H is a near-miss PASS with exactly 1 unmanaged gap of 36s at [06:37] and 1 managed hold of 88s at [11:37]; (2) O is a hard PASS where Kieran mentions a specialist team ([07:46], [08:14]) while taking full personal ownership; (3) RE is verified via both a live caller-ID test ring ([13:04]) and a live telecare pendant call to the monitoring centre ([14:32]).

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Near-miss PASS: Kieran has one 36s unmanaged gap at [06:37] (after [05:51] 'Let me check the SIP voice profile on the exchange switch'), which is below the >=2 threshold, and properly announces/returns from his 88s hold at [09:43]–[11:37].

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Even though Kieran mentions 'our specialist vulnerable-customer engineering desk' at [07:46] and [08:14], he takes full personal ownership of rebuilding the G.711/SIN 227 voice profile himself ([00:54], [07:46], [11:37]) and booking the battery backup unit.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Live resolution confirmed twice: at [13:04] Niamh confirms incoming caller ID displays on the Panasonic handset during Kieran's test ring, and at [14:32]–[15:02] the Tunstall Lifeline Vi+ pendant test succeeds live with the monitoring centre operator.
